content: {"summary":"Customers report a black screen with a spinning wheel that forces frequent restarts, often every 2‑5 minutes, causing lock‑screen loops and battery drain. The issue persists even after factory resets and iOS updates, with many users noting it began on December 2, 2017, and continues to disrupt calls and app usage. Some users have had to change device dates or seek Genius Bar help to mitigate the problem. The widespread frustration highlights a critical bug in iOS 11.1.2 and later versions. [#tk_523837] [#tk_90934] [#tk_518341] [#tk_515888]"}
